scope: Structured history inventory plus four adverse-effect instrument drafts for S12 owner review. No concrete package is approved. S08 no-review exception does not apply here.
owner_questions: Approve the minimum typed history inventory (12 fields, periods, tri-state plus not_assessed, provenance, reconciliation, analysis-visible label) as-is so S27 and S29-S38 can draft against a frozen inventory, or name additions as versioned changes. FR-14-excluded dose/unit/route/frequency/active-stopped/free-text stay excluded.

Review the complete BARS (4 items 0-3/0-3/0-3/0-5, global principal, threshold global>=2) and SAS (10 items 0-4, raw 0-40, mean 0-4, no severity bands) definitions, administration/completeness/scoring, independent examples, and F2/F3 severity/network mappings.

Identify the complete AIMS source/form and review concrete AIMS item/completeness/severity/network definitions; confirm Schooler-Kane research thresholds (3+ in one region or 2+ in two regions with exposure and no alternative cause) as research-only.
Review the Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria checklist (5 criteria items, no total score), completeness-only-when-present rule, reviewed severity wording, and urgent-independent handling.
assumptions: Full standardized questionnaires are selected (2026-10-04); full completion applies only when the corresponding effect is present.
Acute-dystonia form name is Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria; naming does not establish a validated scale.
No summed BARS severity rules, no universal SAS bands, no diagnosis from an AIMS total, and no invented network mappings were added.
mapping_gaps: R7/F5 trial-adequacy windows and no-improvement baselines (S32/S37).
F1-F4 gate wording, onset/alternative-cause fields, and result mappings (S33-S36).
